(1) Non-litigation channels in handling cases of violence against women can be carried out through restorative justice mechanisms and customary justice mechanisms.
(2) Gampong apparatus and other government apparatus are obligated to involve women in the process of resolving violence cases through non-litigation.

6.8.rationale: The Indonesian Pasal 17 provides guarantees for accompanying officers to access information and assist women victims in the legal process. This is a general victim-support/legal assistance provision, not an intersectional measure targeting a specific subgroup defined by ‘legal process involvement’ (e.g., women witnesses, complainants, detainees) as a distinct vulnerable group. The judge appears to have conflated ‘there is legal-process support’ with ‘intersectional approach for women involved in legal processes’ and thus over-labeled Yes.
